traces.claim: Marking visited only when dequeuing is harmless.
steps: A enqueues B and C
B enqueues D but D is not marked yet
C also enqueues D
queue now contains duplicate D entries
traces.broken_invariant: A discovered node should enter the BFS frontier at most once when one shortest parent is enough.

traces.claim: Every priority-queue entry is still the current best priority.
steps: push (10, X)
discover better X and push (4, X)
pop (4, X) and finalize it
old (10, X) remains and must be recognized as stale
traces.broken_invariant: The heap may contain historical entries; only the best-known distance is authoritative.

traces.claim: If a window sum is too large, moving left rightward always moves toward validity without losing future answers.
steps: window [4, -3, 5] has sum 6
removing 4 leaves [-3, 5] with sum 2
but negative values make window sum non-monotonic as boundaries move
a locally invalid/valid decision no longer proves discarded starts are useless
traces.broken_invariant: Boundary movement does not monotonically repair the sum condition when values can be negative.

traces.claim: The smallest tentative distance is always final.
steps: A→B costs 2, A→C costs 5
B appears final at distance 2
C→B has weight -10
route A→C→B later improves B to -5
traces.broken_invariant: Nonnegative edges are required for the finalized-minimum argument.

traces.claim: Any yes/no predicate can be binary searched.
steps: predicate over indices is F,T,F,T,F
checking the middle F gives no safe half to remove
either side can still contain T
halving would discard possible answers without proof
traces.broken_invariant: A binary-search decision needs a monotonic partition or sorted ordering.
